name: Batman Gotham City Escape
description: The crown jewel of Parque Warner Madrid and one of the finest new roller coasters in Europe — Batman Gotham City Escape is a spectacular Intamin LSM multi-launch coaster that opened in 2023 and immediately transformed the park's reputation among European coaster enthusiasts. Plunging riders into a dark and immersive recreation of Gotham City, the ride delivers three powerful magnetic launches, four inversions including a breathtaking 45-metre top hat element, speeds up to 104 km/h and 111 seconds of relentless action that combine hangtime, speed, laterals and genuine terror in equal measure. The onboard soundtrack deepens the Gotham atmosphere throughout. Considered by many enthusiasts to be among the top five roller coasters in Spain, Batman Gotham City Escape single-handedly elevated Parque Warner Madrid into the conversation for the finest theme parks in Southern Europe. Europe's only multi-launch coaster of its kind. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Superman: La Atraccion de Acero
description: The landmark attraction that put Parque Warner Madrid on the European theme park map — Superman: La Atraccion de Acero is a magnificent Bolliger and Mabillard floorless roller coaster and the first of its kind in all of Europe. Standing 55 metres tall and reaching speeds of over 100 km/h through seven inversions, Superman delivers an extraordinary experience where riders sit with their feet dangling completely free beneath the train as it soars, dives and corkscrews through a spectacular layout themed to Superman's flight through Metropolis with the iconic Daily Planet visible from the highest points. The floorless seating format creates a uniquely exposed and exhilarating riding sensation that transforms even familiar inversion sequences into something completely distinctive. A genuine landmark attraction and still the signature thrill experience at Parque Warner Madrid after more than two decades. Min. height: 130cm.

name: Stunt Fall
description: One of the most intense and physically overwhelming roller coasters in Spain — Stunt Fall is a giant inverted boomerang coaster in the Movie World Studios area that launches riders forward through a towering vertical loop and cobra roll at 115 km/h before stopping at a breathtaking vertical height of 65 metres and then sending them backwards through the same horrifying sequence in reverse. The combination of maximum speed, extreme inversions and the reverse-launch format that eliminates any psychological preparation for the second pass through the inversions makes Stunt Fall one of the most reliably terrifying coaster experiences at any Spanish theme park. Inspired by the death-defying stunt sequences of Hollywood action cinema. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Coaster-Express
description: Europe's longest wooden roller coaster and one of the most visually iconic attractions in Spanish theme park history — Coaster-Express is a magnificent GCI wooden coaster in the Old West Territory area with an imposing skyline of interlocking wooden structure visible from every corner of the park. The coaster runs for more than a kilometre through valleys, canyons and sweeping turns past western frontier scenery with a dramatic 45-metre first drop and speeds of up to 95 km/h. Following extensive re-tracking work in recent years Coaster-Express has become significantly smoother than its historically rough reputation suggested and now delivers a genuinely exciting old-school wooden coaster experience with strong lateral forces and the distinctive rumble of wood that enthusiasts treasure. An essential Parque Warner Madrid experience and a genuine European wooden coaster landmark. Min. height: 130cm.

name: La Aventura de Scooby-Doo
description: The most family-friendly interactive attraction at Parque Warner Madrid and a universally beloved experience for visitors of all ages — La Aventura de Scooby-Doo boards guests onto the iconic Mystery Machine for an interactive laser-shooting ghost-hunting adventure through elaborately themed haunted scenes from the beloved Scooby-Doo cartoon universe. Armed with laser guns, riders compete to blast the most ghosts and solve the mystery as Scooby and the gang assist from the walls and corners of each spectacular set. The competitive scoring format makes this endlessly replayable and the quality of the themed environments and character appearances make La Aventura de Scooby-Doo one of the finest Sally Corporation dark rides in Europe. A must-ride for families with younger children. Min. height: no restriction.

name: Police Academy Stunt Show
description: The most spectacular live entertainment offering at Parque Warner Madrid and one of the finest Hollywood-style stunt shows in Europe — the Police Academy Stunt Show is a brilliantly staged live-action extravaganza featuring professional stunt drivers, motorcyclists and pyrotechnic technicians performing car chases, explosions, motorcycle stunts, fire sequences and acrobatic set-pieces in a massive purpose-built stunt arena with stadium seating. The comedy framing and audience interaction sequences make this accessible and entertaining for visitors of all ages while the genuine danger and professional skill of the performers creates genuine edge-of-seat tension throughout. Runs multiple times daily throughout the season. Suitable for all ages.

name: Wild Falls
description: The most refreshing and popular water attraction at Parque Warner Madrid — Wild Falls is a classic log flume ride through the wild west sawmill landscape of Old West Territory that delivers a guaranteed complete soaking at its dramatic final drop. The theming throughout the queue and ride area is richly atmospheric with authentic frontier architecture, working mill machinery and beautiful desert canyon rockwork creating one of the finest themed water ride environments at any Spanish theme park. Particularly popular during the peak Madrid summer heat. Suitable for all ages — adults required for the very smallest visitors.

name: Tom and Jerry Roller Coaster
description: A joyfully themed family coaster in Cartoon Village that takes younger riders through a whimsical picnic landscape inspired by the iconic Tom and Jerry cartoon series — complete with oversized sandwiches, teacups, garden furniture and the beloved characters themselves frozen in classic chase poses throughout the scenery. Tom and Jerry is an ideal first roller coaster experience for children providing genuine mild thrills within a completely safe and child-friendly environment. The Zierer Tivoli Large format delivers a smooth and comfortable ride that parents and grandparents can enjoy alongside smaller children. Min. height: 121cm.

name: Correcaminos Bip Bip
description: The fastest junior coaster in Cartoon Village and a beloved family attraction inspired by the legendary Looney Tunes rivalry between Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner — Correcaminos Bip Bip sends families racing through a desert canyon landscape at genuine speed with surprising drops and energetic turns that make it far more thrilling than its family classification suggests. The Looney Tunes theming is executed with real charm and the queue area is filled with entertaining references to the Road Runner cartoon series. A consistently popular attraction that provides a confident step up in thrill level for children who have outgrown the gentle family rides. Min. height: 120cm.

name: The Inverter
description: A diabolically disorienting flat ride in the DC Super Heroes World area themed to the villainous machinations of Lex Luthor and his Lex Corp — The Inverter is a spinning, rotating thrill machine that subjects riders to relentless rotation in multiple axes simultaneously creating a uniquely chaotic and stomach-churning experience that leaves even experienced thrill-seekers grateful for solid ground. The Lex Corp theming frames the experience as one of Luthor's evil inventions gone gloriously wrong. Min. height: 140cm.

name: The Joker Bumper Cars
description: A chaotic and entertaining classic bumper car experience in the atmospheric Gotham City area of DC Super Heroes World — The Joker Bumper Cars takes place on a dark indoor track decorated with Joker imagery, playing card motifs and the anarchic aesthetic of the Clown Prince of Crime's lair. The combination of the genuinely creative Gotham City theming and the universal appeal of bumper cars makes this a consistently popular family attraction that works equally well for the youngest visitors and adults who need a break from the coasters. Min. height: 110cm.

name: Haunted Hotel
description: A classic dark ride attraction in the Movie World Studios area themed to an abandoned Hollywood hotel haunted by the eternally waiting ghost of Isabel — Haunted Hotel takes visitors through a series of elaborately decorated gothic chambers filled with atmospheric effects, ghostly apparitions, sudden scares and genuinely impressive practical special effects in a slow-moving dark ride format that is unsettling enough to thrill older visitors while stopping short of being genuinely terrifying for younger ones. One of the most thematically distinctive and atmospheric non-coaster attractions at the park. Suitable for most ages.

name: Cine Tour
description: A gentle and atmospheric family tram ride through the Hollywood Boulevard and Movie World Studios area of Parque Warner Madrid — Cine Tour transports visitors on a narrated journey past magnificent recreated Californian film studio landscapes from the golden age of Hollywood in the 1930s, with authentic movie set facades, vintage automobiles, period props and the glamorous architecture of old Hollywood recreated with genuine attention to detail. Accessible to all visitors including wheelchair users. A perfect choice for families seeking a relaxed and visually rewarding experience between more intense attractions. Suitable for all ages.

name: Canyon Mine Crazy Minecart
description: A wildly unpredictable spinning minecart ride in the Old West Territory that sends riders in out-of-control spinning carts through a dramatic canyon mine landscape with sudden turns, unexpected drops and rapid rotation that makes it impossible to predict what is coming next at any moment throughout the ride. The gold rush mine theming is excellently executed with authentic mining equipment, geological formations and frontier props throughout the canyon setting. A thoroughly entertaining and highly rerideable attraction that provides excellent thrills without the height requirements of the major coasters. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Cohetes Espaciales
description: A charming and entertaining flying rocket ride in Cartoon Village featuring Marvin the Martian and his loyal K-9 companion aboard flying spacecraft — Cohetes Espaciales allows families to pilot their own rocket ships through a gentle circular flight path while controlling the height of their vehicle for a personalised flying experience. The Marvin the Martian theming with authentic Looney Tunes space imagery and the beloved character's distinctive helmet and ray gun decorating the ride vehicles makes this one of the most photogenic and character-rich attractions for younger visitors in the Cartoon Village area. Suitable for young children with adult accompaniment.
